newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber down in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber down in quiet trade.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices fell in early trading as the market continued to drift from an absence of consumer interest, traders said.

At midday, the Malaysian Rubber Exchange and Licensing Board quoted July RSS1 buyer at 282 Malaysian/Singapore cents ($1.12) a kg, down half cent from Monday's close. July SMR20 buyer was priced 1.50 cents lower at 260.50.
Dealers could not report any inquiries or business in the first session, and doubted that there would be any change in sentiment in later trading.
"I think we'll see another downward adjustment this evening," said a dealer.
A check with trading houses at noon showed the SMR 20 offered at 259 cents, SMR 10 at 261, SMR 5 at 271, SMR CV at 330, SMR L at 307, and drum latex at 226
A Malaysian-based shipping agent quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $800 per TEU and $1,700 per two-TEU containers.
